# Nexa Horse Transport

> Horse transport company based in Sundre, Alberta, Canada. Local and regional horse hauling across Alberta, a scheduled coast-to-coast route every two weeks (Langley, BC to Halifax, NS), and horse transport between Canada and the USA. A brand of Nexa Line Ltd., an Alberta corporation.

- Phone: 1-844-491-NEXA (1-844-491-6392)
- Email: nexahorsetransport@gmail.com
- Equipment: 2026 Ford F-350 dually with a Four Star 6+1 straight-load gooseneck horse trailer; standard, roomier and box stalls
- Pricing: Canadian dollars, per horse, per kilometre, plus GST; $300 minimum per trip; vet, border, government and customs broker fees at cost; no booking fees. Online estimates are confirmed by phone or email.
- Trips with both ends in Canada stay on Canadian highways.
